Title: Multi-stage Dockerfile parser
Description: YAMLess reads only the first FROM directive. Multi-stage Dockerfiles (frontend-builder then runtime) cause the wrong runtime to be detected, cascading into wrong dependency parser and missing all backend dependencies.

Title: Monorepo detection and inner package.json resolution
Description: Root package.json is the workspace manifest in pnpm/Yarn/Nx monorepos. App dependencies live in a nested package (e.g. ghost/package.json). Analyzer must detect pnpm-workspace.yaml / nx.json / lerna.json and walk to the correct inner package.

Title: MySQL/MariaDB Terraform module
Description: mysql2 is detected in DB packages but no Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server module exists. Profile carries database: mysql and silently skips the database module block.

Title: Fix DATABASE_URL drop when has_postgres = False
Description: DATABASE_URL is excluded from kv_secret_names as infra-managed even when no Postgres module is rendered. Container fails at startup because the secret is never provisioned in Key Vault.

Title: Multi-shape model for web + worker from one repo
Description: Apps like Redash run a web server and rq/Celery workers from the same codebase as separate processes. AppProfile supports only one shape. A workers list field is needed so both shapes can be rendered as separate Container Apps / Deployments.

Title: Prefer pyproject.toml over package.json when both present
Description: When a repo has both a root package.json (frontend tooling) and pyproject.toml (Python backend), the Node parser can win by mistake. Python manifests should take precedence for backend dependency classification.

Title: Recursive secret scanning for monorepos
Description: Env scanner looks only at the repo root. Nested .env* files and dot-notation config files (Ghost config.*.json with database__connection__password keys) are not read.

Title: Redis / Azure Cache for Redis Terraform module
Description: Redis is detected (cache: true) but no module is rendered. An Azure Cache for Redis module should be added to both Container Apps and AKS renderers.
